title: Order
description: One order (Or): a dated statement from the commander, held verbatim. The text of an order is never edited, only moved. Filed by identifier, Or001.json.

kind.description: the word order, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this order's identifier, Or and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

date.description: the day the commander said it, YYYY-MM-DD

session.description: the eight-character id of the session the order was given in

text.description: the commander's own words, verbatim and never edited

superseded_by.description: the identifier of the later order that overrides this one, and nothing else; absent while the order stands

superseded_note.description: how and why it was superseded, in prose, when the identifier alone does not tell the story
